baseline_rule: At t=0 baseline-subtracted concentration = 0. For the digitized postdose absolute group mean and mean predose b, subtract b at all >0h points. This yields AUC_corrected = AUC_traced_with_t0_zero - 23.5*b. b is NOT measured in the Figure. No negative baselines allowed in main scenarios.
dose_interpretation: Do NOT derive dosing recommendations. The 0.5 and 0.25 profiles are subjective reading hypotheses with explicit wide intervals, not new empirical human data; published Table AUC is not an independent holdout.
